tasks.label: Conan: Create Lockfile
tasks.detail: Pin all dep versions to conan.lock — run after changing conanfile.py
tasks.command: bash -c 'case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) ARCH=x86_64;; aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64;; *) echo "Error: Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1;; esac && conan lock create . --profile=conan/profiles/${ARCH}/release --lockfile-out=conan.lock'

tasks.label: CI: Check Format (C++)
tasks.detail: Dry-run clang-format — fails if any file needs reformatting
tasks.command: find libs proto -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' \) | xargs -r clang-format-18 --dry-run --Werror
